title: Utility Rates Review Council Act
verified_how: Register page 'UTILITY RATES REVIEW COUNCIL ACT, Consolidation of', listed under U in the Current Consolidated Statutes and Regulations. The consolidation PDF's cover prints 'CONSOLIDATION OF UTILITY RATES REVIEW COUNCIL ACT / S.Nu. 2001,c.3 / In force March 31, 2001, except s.22 / s.22 in force March 30, 2001 / (Current to: October 14, 2010)', amended by S.Nu. 2010,c.3,s.18 and S.Nu. 2010,c.6 (in force March 23, 2010). Its running footer repeats 'Utility Rates Review Council Act, Consolidation of - Current to: 2010-10-14'. Its table of contents shows the operative headings 'PROPOSED RATES AND TARIFFS', 'Imposition of rates and tariffs' (s. 12.1), 'Application for approval of rate or tariff' and 'Interim rate or tariff'. Cross-checked against the Official Consolidation of the Qulliq Energy Corporation Act, C.S.Nu., c.Q-20 (consolidation date November 7, 2024), whose s. 5(e) empowers the corporation 'subject to the Utility Rates Review Council Act, to set rates and tariffs' - confirming this Act as the rate-setting control. In force; not repealed.
notes: A Nunavut statute of its own (not carried over). Nunavut has no Public Utilities Act and no standing utilities board: this Act creates the Utility Rates Review Council, which reviews and advises on rate and tariff applications, with approval resting with the responsible Minister/Executive Council. The utility itself is constituted by the Qulliq Energy Corporation Act, C.S.Nu., c.Q-20 - an Official Consolidation, and itself a carried-over NWT Act (R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.N-2, the former Northwest Territories Power Corporation Act). CAUTION: this Act is published only as an UNOFFICIAL consolidation and the register's own text is current only to 14 October 2010, so amendments after that date are not reflected.
